---
title: Frontend optimization with pnpm
description: Use this prompt to optimize pnpm-based frontend code, scripts, dependencies, and build configuration for a TypeScript/JavaScript website.
---

Use this prompt when you want the agent to improve website performance, reduce bundle size, or tune pnpm workflows.

Example requests:
- "Review the project dependencies and suggest pnpm optimizations for faster installs and smaller builds."
- "Improve the Next.js build configuration and remove unused imports to reduce bundle size."
- "Add or refine pnpm scripts for development, linting, formatting, and production build." 
- "Suggest TypeScript and JS improvements for frontend performance and code quality."

Provide any additional context about your project structure, current build problems, or the files you want analyzed.
